sentences.en: Many people think South America is hot and full of rainforests.
sentences.zh: 很多人认为南美洲又热又有大片热带雨林。

sentences.en: South America has a lot of diverse cultures, from Brazil to Argentina.
sentences.zh: 从巴西到阿根廷，南美洲有很多不同的文化。

sentences.en: I dream of traveling to South America someday and seeing Machu Picchu.
sentences.zh: 我梦想有一天能去南美洲看看马丘比丘。
